## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4c4a2b7305fca08623b38b4663a3c8c9a743cbec`
Local-runs: probe — the finished record text was fed once to the record reader (`contractReviewRecordReading`) to confirm it parses as one verdict line and one named finding; nothing of the PR was built, run or re-run
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none

Inputs read: card 33749 (body, 3 comments, the os-dev-report 6896252482 among them), PR 33939 (body, file list, net diff against `main` 895783a1: 3 files, +5 / -5), the 46 check-runs on this head. Read to judge, not reviewed: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (the record reader), `SKILL.md`, `references/lanes/skills.md`, `references/lanes/review.md`, `references/execution-duties.md`, all on `origin/main`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Published accept set and public surface: none touched. The diff is three files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`; no package, schema, script, workflow or changeset. Right.
- Governed rule surface (rules face, hence this tier): five lines of operative rule text change.
  - `contract-review.md` L42 (N2): the nit route gains the pointer to `filing-gate.md`; 「原复核者」 is the spelling `lanes/review.md` already uses for the delta reviewer. No rule moved. Right.
  - `contract-review.md` L51 (N6): pre-check ① now reads the newest same-head record and counts only unclosed findings of the two upper grades. Narrower than main's wording in one direction (an older clean PASS no longer suffices once a later record raises a finding) and wider in the other (a finding closed by a later record no longer blocks). Both directions are what the guard already enforces, see ④. Right.
  - `filing-gate.md` L35 (N5): spelling and a separator only. Right.
  - `triage-duties.md` L16 (N3): cadence unchanged, anchor added. Right, with a nit in ④.
  - `triage-duties.md` L74 (N4): the actor and the time of the skills-text card move from triage (first touch) to the landing seat (after the merge), and the ADR card gains the `domain:skills` label and folds into the same per-PR card. This is a change of ownership, not of wording. Wrong as landed, see ④ M1.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — holds. Nothing published changes, so no level is owed: the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR, the `Check Changeset` run on this head concluded success, and no `.changeset/*` file is in the diff. The label matches what the diff publishes (nothing).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags: none raised (`security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`). The claim's file surface (the three reference files) held: the file list is exactly those three.
- open_questions, the one entry (N4, reading A vs B): NOT answered in favour of A, and escalated. A as landed contradicts rule text on `main` (④ M1). B, by the dev's own account, changes the per-PR unit of the ruling the card cites. Either reading therefore moves a rule (ownership or unit), and `lanes/skills.md` routes that to a decision card first (「改规则(归属、门禁、上限、车道边界)先立决策卡,裁后本域写」). A wording-nit card carries no such ruling. The fork goes to the maintainer through a decision card; this PR should leave L74's actors as `main` has them.
- PR author: `user.login` reads `objectstack-fleet[bot]` on the pull object; no off-relay author to name.
- SQL push-down (AGENTS.md): n/a — no query, driver or data-path code in the diff.
- Check-runs on this head: 46 total; no red. Still in progress at the time of this read, so NOT yet gate verdicts: `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`. Concluded success: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, the three scoped Lint jobs, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `filter`, `Auto Label`; the rest skipped. The pm-skill ratchet and id-lint ride on the pending `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`; the landing pre-check ② waits for it.

### ④ Design judgment

**`contract-review.md`**

- N6, L51 「现 head 末条同形达档 PASS,无未闭前两级」 — holds against the guard on `origin/main`. `recordPassVerdict` in `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` reads the ONE record the locator chose (the newest `## Contract review` naming the current head, on the PR thread or the card's), requires exactly one `VERDICT:` line reading PASS, and refuses when that same record names an open finding of the two upper grades, reads a contradicting verdict elsewhere, or carries a grade mention it cannot attribute; its docblock says a later same-head record that closes the findings is the one that clears, and a later non-PASS withdraws an earlier PASS. 「末条」 is the newest-governs choice and 「未闭」 is the reader's `open` set (a finding closed as `S1: closed` is not in it). Tried to break it: an older clean PASS followed by a record raising a finding (guard refuses; new text refuses; main's text passed it), and a first record with a finding followed by a closing delta (guard clears; new text clears; main's text was silent). The text now matches the guard in both. Dropping 「两条」 loses nothing: ① here and ② at L54 still number themselves.
- N2, L41-42 — holds. The pointer lands where the title, the append rule and the search live (`filing-gate.md` L35-37). 「原复核者」 agrees with `lanes/review.md` 「delta 复审归原复核者」.
- Nit Na: 「只改散文面」 became 「改散文面」. The 「只」 said the nit fix must touch nothing but prose faces; L52 (「只动散文面原记录续管」) still carries that condition for the head-move case, so no rule is lost, but the two lines no longer say it the same way.

**`filing-gate.md`**

- N5, L35 — holds. 「接受的偏差」 now matches `contract-review.md` L42; the title code span is separated from 「逐项勾」; `/` as the in-parenthesis separator is the file's own (「文案/文档」 on the next line). `PR #N` is the pre-existing placeholder, not a tracker number.

**`triage-duties.md`**

- N3, L16 — the anchor is readable: 「小时轮」 is defined at L6 of the same file, and both ways of cutting the phrase (「每 3 个 / 小时轮 / 报」 and 「每 3 个小时 / 轮报」) give the same cadence, so no seat can act wrongly on it.
- Nit Nb: the phrase does cut two ways, and the first cut reads as a count of rounds while L9 of the same file says the tier is chosen by fire time and never by a counter. A spelling that names the clock (for example the fire hours) would remove both.
- M1 (must-fix) — N4, L74 moves the skills-text card to the landing seat after the merge, and rule text on `main` says otherwise. `lanes/skills.md` 范围: 「发布技能 `skills/**` 走子卡:修复改了作者或 agent 被教的内容 ⇒ 分诊首触即立本域子卡」, 「子卡带 `Blocked-by:` 产品卡 … 产品 PR 正文点名该子卡」. The new L74 sits directly under L73 (the first-touch done-when line for the same cards) and now tells the triage seat that the skills-text card is the landing seat's, filed after the merge, one per PR. A seat that follows L74 files no child card at first touch, so the product PR has no child card to name in its body and the `Blocked-by:` ordering has nothing to hang on; a seat that follows `lanes/skills.md` and a landing seat that follows L74 file two cards for one text change. On `main` the two agree (the skills half carries no actor in a triage file, so it is triage's, at first touch); this diff introduces the disagreement. `execution-duties.md` 「各立 `domain:skills` 卡」 and its ADR line (landing seat, `carrier:` note at ACCEPT, card after the merge) cover the ADR half only and do not license the move of the skills half. And the move is an ownership change made under a wording-nit card: `lanes/skills.md` requires a decision card before a rule's ownership moves, and the dev's report names this very point as its open question. Fix, either: (a) keep `main`'s actors on L74 and repair only what wording can (the ADR half's count, the 「每 PR」 unit stated for the skills half without moving who files it), leaving the fork to a decision card; or (b) carry the ruling first, then move L74 AND `lanes/skills.md` in the same change so the two agree.
- The rest of L74 against other rule text: `filing-gate.md` L37 (「技能/ADR 文本卡照 `triage-duties.md`」) still resolves; `SKILL.md`'s domain table places `docs/adr/**` in `domain:skills`, so the label on the ADR half is not itself wrong. No AGENTS.md sentence speaks to who files these cards.

**Ratchet and id-lint, read off the tree (not run):** line counts are unchanged against `origin/main` (contract-review.md 63, triage-duties.md 104, filing-gate.md 82; +5 / -5, 0 net). The five touched lines measure 118, 119, 120, 120 and 105 bytes (L42, L51 of contract-review.md; L35 of filing-gate.md; L16, L74 of triage-duties.md), none above 120; no line was re-wrapped to pay for another. No issue number was added to operative text. The gate's own verdict is the pending `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` run.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none

Delta round on the head that follows `4c4a2b73` by one commit (record 6896322254: one finding, M1, and nits Na, Nb). Inputs read: card 33749 with every comment (the round-1 os-dev-report 6896444861 among them), PR 33939 (body, file list, the one-commit delta and the net diff against `main` 895783a1: 3 files, +6 / -6), the 47 check-runs on this head. Read to judge, not reviewed: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `SKILL.md`, `references/lanes/skills.md`, `references/lanes/review.md`, `references/execution-duties.md`, all on `origin/main`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Published accept set and public surface: none touched; still three reference files, no package, schema, script, workflow or changeset. Right.
- Governed rule surface, net against `main`:
  - `contract-review.md` L41-42 (N2, Na): the pointer to `filing-gate.md` and 「原复核者」 as before; 「只改散文面」 is back; 「正确性」 reads 「正确」 and 「由」 sits at the end of L41. No rule moved. Right.
  - `contract-review.md` L51 (N6): unchanged by the delta; judged right on the previous head and still so.
  - `filing-gate.md` L35 (N5): unchanged by the delta. Right.
  - `triage-duties.md` L16 (N3, Nb): the 3-hour cadence now names its clock. Cadence unchanged. Right.
  - `triage-duties.md` L74 (N4): the actors are `main`'s again; the only change against `main` is that the per-PR unit now covers the ADR half as well. No ownership moves. Right.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — holds. Nothing published changes; the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR, no `.changeset/*` file is in the diff, and both `Check Changeset` runs on this head concluded skipped (none red). No level is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags: none (`security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`); the file list is still exactly the three claimed files.
- open_questions: the round-1 report carries none. The round-0 entry (N4, reading A vs B) is answered by this head taking neither: L74 keeps the filers `main` has, so no ruling is needed for this PR. Whether the skills-text card should ever move to the landing seat remains a decision-card matter and is not owed here.
- PR author: `user.login` reads `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay author to name.
- SQL push-down (AGENTS.md): n/a — no query, driver or data-path code in the diff.
- Check-runs on this head: 47, all completed, none red, none pending. Concluded success, among them: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (carries the pm-skill ratchet and id-lint), `Lint & Repo Gates`, the other `Lint ·` jobs, `TypeScript Type Check` and the four `Type Check ·` jobs, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` (both), `Check PR Size`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `filter`. The rest skipped.

### ④ Design judgment

**`triage-duties.md`**

- M1: closed. L74 now reads 「ADR/技能文本携带注记 ⛔ 不挂实施卡,每实施 PR 一 `domain:skills` 卡;ADR 由落地席合并后立。」 The skills half names no actor in the triage file, so it is triage's at first touch, which is what `lanes/skills.md` says (「分诊首触即立本域子卡」, child card `Blocked-by:` the product card, named in the product PR body); the ADR half stays with the landing seat after the merge, as `execution-duties.md` has it. The two files agree again, the product PR has its child card to name, and no ownership moved under a nit card. Tried to break it: a triage seat reading L73 then L74 files the child card at first touch (same as `main`); a landing seat reading L74 files only the ADR card (same as `main`); `filing-gate.md` L37 still resolves here.
- Nit Nc: 「每实施 PR 一」 now governs both halves while the two halves have different filers and times, so the line does not say whether a PR that owes both gets one shared card or one each; and at first touch the PR the unit counts by usually does not exist yet, the residue of the card's N4. Neither reading makes a seat act wrongly (the search-and-append rule in `filing-gate.md` covers the overlap). For the follow-up card.
- Nb: closed. L16 「UTC 3 倍数时的轮次记录报 24h 流量」 cuts one way only (the round records fired at UTC hours 0, 3, … 21), keeps the 3-hour cadence, and is decided by fire time, which is how L9 of the same file chooses its tier (「选层按 fire 时刻 ⛔ 不用计数器」).

**`contract-review.md`**

- Na: closed. 「只改散文面」 is restored, so L42 and L52 state the prose-only condition the same way again.
- The payment: 「(无碍正确与契约)」 for 「(无碍正确性与契约)」 keeps the nit definition (no harm to correctness or to the contract); no reader of the grade, human or the record reader, keys on the dropped character. 「由」 moving to the end of L41 stays inside the same bullet and the same two lines: the sentence is unchanged and no line was gained or borrowed from another bullet. No rule lost.
- N6 (L51) and N2: untouched by the delta beyond the above; the previous record's reading against `recordPassVerdict` on `origin/main` stands.

**`filing-gate.md`**

- Untouched by the delta; N5 holds as judged.

**Ratchet and id-lint, read off the tree (not run):** line counts equal `main`'s (contract-review.md 63, triage-duties.md 104, filing-gate.md 82; +6 / -6, 0 net). The six touched lines measure 120, 118, 119 (L41, L42, L51 of contract-review.md), 120 (L35 of filing-gate.md), 120 and 119 bytes (L16, L74 of triage-duties.md); none above 120. No issue number was added to operative text. The gate's own verdict is the `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` run above, concluded success.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
